text.en: The regions where Ainu was definitely spoken in the past are all of Hokkaido, southern Sakhalin, and the Kuril Islands ⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--the-regions-where-ainu-was-definitely-spoken-in⟧. More broadly, the Ainu formerly inhabited Hokkaido, northern Honshu, southern Sakhalin, the Kuril Islands, and southern Kamchatka ⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--the-ainu-formerly-inhabited-hokkaido-northern-honshu-southern⟧, and Ainu is thought to have been spoken anciently at least in the northern part of the Tohoku region on Honshu ⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--ainu-was-historically-spoken-in-hokkaido-sakhalin-and⟧. In modern times, the Ainu people were settled in Hokkaido, Sakhalin, and the Kuril Islands ⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--in-modern-times-the-ainu-people-were-settled⟧. Nakagawa proposes that a small number of people may have migrated and spoken Ainu at the southern tip of the Kamchatka Peninsula and in the Amur River basin ⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--there-is-a-possibility-that-a-small-number⟧. There is, however, no historical record or evidence of an enduring Ainu-speaking community on the Asian continent ⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--no-historical-record-ainu-continent⟧.
text.ja: かつてアイヌ語が話されていた地域として確実に挙げることができるのは、北海道全域、樺太南部および千島列島である⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--the-regions-where-ainu-was-definitely-spoken-in⟧。より広くは、アイヌはかつて北海道だけでなく、本州北部、樺太南部、千島列島、カムチャツカ南部に居住していた⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--the-ainu-formerly-inhabited-hokkaido-northern-honshu-southern⟧。アイヌ語は古くは本州東北地方の少なくとも北部でも話されていたと考えられている⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--ainu-was-historically-spoken-in-hokkaido-sakhalin-and⟧。近代において、アイヌ民族は北海道、樺太、千島列島に定住していた⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--in-modern-times-the-ainu-people-were-settled⟧。中川は、カムチャッカ半島の南端やアムール川流域にも少数の人が移住してアイヌ語を話していた可能性があると提案している⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--there-is-a-possibility-that-a-small-number⟧。しかし、ユーラシア大陸においてアイヌ語が話されていた長期的なコミュニティが存在したことを示す歴史的記録や証拠はない⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--no-historical-record-ainu-continent⟧。

text.en: Ainu is held to be the sole surviving language of the original linguistic diversity of Jōmon Japan ⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--ainu-sole-survivor-jomon⟧. Janhunen asserts that Proto-Ainu was not originally native to Hokkaido but relocated there from Honshu in connection with the expansion of the Satsumon culture ⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--proto-ainu-relocated-from-honshu⟧, and that Proto-Ainu, which he terms Proto-Kurilic, was spoken on Hokkaido during the period of the Satsumon culture, approximately 500 to 1,000 years ago ⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--proto-ainu-proto-kurilic-was-spoken-on-hokkaido⟧. The Ainu linguistic lineage has absorbed elements from Japanese, the language or languages of the Okhotsk people, and contact languages of Jōmon and Epi-Jōmon populations on Honshu and Hokkaido ⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--the-ainu-linguistic-lineage-has-absorbed-elements-from⟧, and the Okhotsk culture population itself underwent language shift to Ainu ⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--the-okhotsk-culture-population-underwent-language-shift-to⟧.
text.ja: アイヌ語は縄文時代の日本列島がもっていた本来の言語的多様性の唯一の生き残り言語であるとされる⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--ainu-sole-survivor-jomon⟧。Janhunenは、祖アイヌ語は元来北海道にあったものではなく、擦文文化の拡大に伴って本州から移入されたものであると主張する⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--proto-ainu-relocated-from-honshu⟧。彼が祖千島語と呼ぶ祖アイヌ語は、擦文文化の時代、おそらく500年以上前かつ1000年未満前に北海道で話されていたとされる⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--proto-ainu-proto-kurilic-was-spoken-on-hokkaido⟧。アイヌ語の言語系統は、日本語やオホーツク文化の人々の言語、さらには本州や北海道の縄文・続縄文集団の諸言語から要素を取り込んできた⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--the-ainu-linguistic-lineage-has-absorbed-elements-from⟧。また、オホーツク文化集団もアイヌ語への言語交替を起こした⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--the-okhotsk-culture-population-underwent-language-shift-to⟧。

text.en: Family names were not used in Ainu society before 1868, when Japanese family names were adopted ⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--family-names-were-not-used-in-ainu-society⟧.
text.ja: アイヌ社会では1868年に日本の名字が導入されるまで家名は使用されていなかった⟦claim:sources/ainu-people-homeland-history--family-names-were-not-used-in-ainu-society⟧。
